programs.name: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: AAA (AAB including A in computer science)
programs.ib_offer: 34 points overall or 666 in 3 Higher Level certificates. If taking Higher Level Computer Science: 32 points including HL 6 in computer science, or 665 in 3 HL certificates including HL 6 in Computer Science.
programs.ap_offer: Nottingham's United States page (no course-specific AP offer is published): as a minimum, typically 3 approved AP exams ranging 5,5,5 to 4,4,4, or 3 Honors classes ranging A+,A,A to B+,B+,B+, or a combination of 3 distinct AP exams, Honors classes and college-level/dual-enrolment classes. Many courses have higher requirements than this minimum and subject preferences may apply. SAT/ACT are not generally required.
programs.required_subjects: GCSE maths grade 5 (B) and GCSE English grade 4 (C) (IB Maths AA or AI at HL 4 / SL 5 accepted in lieu of GCSE maths). No named A-level subject is listed; the AAB offer needs an A in computer science.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT for this course (6.5 / 6.0 IELTS band): tests up to Jan 2026 (0-120 scale) 90 overall with at least 19 in Writing and Listening, 20 in Reading and 22 in Speaking; tests after Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with at least 4.5 in each element.
programs.english_note: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element). Also accepted: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE (71 overall, minimum 65), GCSE, IB and O level English; see the equivalencies page.
programs.notes: Campus: Jubilee Campus. 2027 entry values. Contextual offers exist for Home/UK fee-status applicants only. AP route: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/country-info/countryinformation/usa.aspx . English test scores: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/english-language/english-language-equivalencies.aspx (equivalencies table last updated November 2025; columns matched to the course's IELTS row). International fee: the international tab shows the amount without a year label; the UK tab of the same page is labelled 2027/28 and the entry requirements apply to 2027 entry.

programs.name: Economics BSc (Hons)
programs.ib_offer: 36 points overall or 766 in 3 Higher Level certificates. Alternatively, 34 points including HL mathematics or 666 in 3 HL certificates including mathematics.
programs.ap_offer: Nottingham's United States page (no course-specific AP offer is published): as a minimum, typically 3 approved AP exams ranging 5,5,5 to 4,4,4, or 3 Honors classes ranging A+,A,A to B+,B+,B+, or a combination of 3 distinct AP exams, Honors classes and college-level/dual-enrolment classes. Many courses have higher requirements than this minimum and subject preferences may apply. SAT/ACT are not generally required.
programs.required_subjects: GCSE maths grade 7 (A) or above (or IB 6 in SL or 4 in HL maths), unless taking maths at A level; GCSE English grade 4 (C).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT for this course (6.5 / 6.0 IELTS band): tests up to Jan 2026 (0-120 scale) 90 overall with at least 19 in Writing and Listening, 20 in Reading and 22 in Speaking; tests after Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with at least 4.5 in each element.
programs.english_note: IELTS 6.5 (no less than 6.0 in any element). Also accepted: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE (71 overall, minimum 65), GCSE, IB and O level English; see the equivalencies page.
programs.notes: Campus: University Park. 2027 entry values. A one-grade-reduced offer is available with an A in an EPQ, Core Maths, IB Extended Essay (B also accepted) or an additional AS level (Additional Qualifications Offer Reduction Scheme, extra eligibility rules apply). AP route: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/country-info/countryinformation/usa.aspx . English test scores: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/english-language/english-language-equivalencies.aspx (equivalencies table last updated November 2025; columns matched to the course's IELTS row). International fee: the international tab shows the amount without a year label; the UK tab of the same page is labelled 2027/28 and the entry requirements apply to 2027 entry.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng (Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: AAA, including A in maths and either physics or further maths or any two of chemistry, biology, design, electronics
programs.ib_offer: 34 points overall or 666 in 3 Higher Level certificates, including one of: HL6 in Mathematics Analysis and Approaches, HL6 in Mathematics Applications and Interpretation, or SL7 in Mathematics Analysis and Approaches plus HL6 or SL7 in physics (Applications and Interpretation not accepted at SL; only one of maths or physics may be at SL).
programs.ap_offer: Nottingham's United States page (no course-specific AP offer is published): as a minimum, typically 3 approved AP exams ranging 5,5,5 to 4,4,4, or 3 Honors classes ranging A+,A,A to B+,B+,B+, or a combination of 3 distinct AP exams, Honors classes and college-level/dual-enrolment classes. Many courses have higher requirements than this minimum and subject preferences may apply. SAT/ACT are not generally required.
programs.required_subjects: A level maths (A) and either physics or further maths or any two of chemistry, biology, design, electronics; GCSE English grade 4 (C).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT for this course (6.0 / 5.5 IELTS band): tests up to Jan 2026 (0-120 scale) 80 overall with at least 17 in Writing and Listening, 18 in Reading and 20 in Speaking; tests after Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in each element.
programs.english_note: IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element). Also accepted: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE (65 overall, minimum 59), GCSE, IB and O level English; see the equivalencies page.
programs.notes: BEng chosen as the 3-year course (the 4-year MEng, UCAS H300, asks A*AA / IB 36 and is a separate page). Campus: University Park. 2027 entry values. AP route: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/country-info/countryinformation/usa.aspx . English test scores: https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/studywithus/international-applicants/english-language/english-language-equivalencies.aspx (equivalencies table last updated November 2025; columns matched to the course's IELTS row). International fee: the international tab shows the amount without a year label; the UK tab of the same page is labelled 2027/28 and the entry requirements apply to 2027 entry.
